description: Android activity class ContentInfoActivity displaying detailed content info UI with focusable action buttons, date/time, and content metadata. Implements user interaction, focus animations, and intent creation.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: Android activity for displaying detailed content information with focusable action buttons, date/time, and content metadata.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, populates data, sets up buttons, and default focus.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Sets current system date and time in UI elements.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Populates UI with content data from intent extras or defaults.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes action buttons, sets icons, labels, focus, and click handlers.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates focus state changes for action buttons.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Handles action button clicks with animations and placeholder logic.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles D-PAD navigation and selection via hardware keys.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Factory method to create intent with content metadata for launching ContentInfoActivity.
